> **Pipeline step 00-1 — data preparation.**
>
> **Purpose.** Turn the survey-supplied tow and fish tables into the four modelling frames every
> model, diagnostic and figure in this repository reads:
>
> | file | rows | used by |
> |---|---|---|
> | `tow_12_6_tps_nona.csv` | 838 | TPS landscape catch models (`01_tps_catch_models/tps_catch_landscape_models.Rmd`) |
> | `tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona.csv` | 818 | TPS water-quality / edge catch models (`01_tps_catch_models/tps_catch_wq_models.Rmd`) |
> | `tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona.csv` | 4,241 | EDSM catch models (`02_edsm_catch_models/edsm_catch_kfold_models.Rmd`) |
> | `tps_forklength_data.csv` | 134 | TPS fork-length models (`03_tps_forklength_models/`) |
>
> **Inputs (supplied by the survey programs, not downloaded by code).**
> `data/All_Surveys_Combined_v7.3.csv` — one row per tow, TPS + EDSM (+ SKT, dropped here), with
> catch, effort (`Volume`), water quality, distances, habitat/edge class and
> `OUT_Moving_Mean_30d` (30-day trailing mean Delta outflow, cfs) already attached.
> `data/TPSCatchWithCSLength.csv` — one row per measured TPS Chinook.
>
> **Outputs.** written to `OUT_DIR` (default `data/rebuilt/`, so the files the published fits were
> built from are never overwritten). The final chunk checks the rebuilt files against `data/`.
> Set `OUT_DIR <- "data"` only to regenerate in place.
>
> **Cost.** Seconds.
>
> Extracted from the project's original exploratory notebooks
> (`tidal-parr-trawl-analysis2_offset_fix.Rmd`, `tidal-parr-forklength-analysis2.Rmd`); the
> modelling-frame logic is unchanged.

```{r project-root, include=FALSE}
# Every path in this notebook (data/, fits_*/, output_figs/, cache/) is relative to the
# REPOSITORY ROOT, not to this file's sub-folder. Walk up from the working directory to the
# folder holding the .Rproj file, and make knitr (and RStudio's chunk-by-chunk notebook
# mode) run every chunk from there. Base R only -- no extra package needed.
find_repo_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  p <- normalizePath(path)
  while (!length(list.files(p, pattern = "\\.Rproj$"))) {
    if (dirname(p) == p) stop("No .Rproj file found above ", path)
    p <- dirname(p)
  }
  p
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = find_repo_root())
```

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(EflowStats)   # get_waterYear(), get_waterYearDay(): US water year (Oct 1 - Sep 30)
library(oce)          # swSCTp(): practical salinity (PSS-78) from conductivity

OUT_DIR <- "data/rebuilt"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Combined tow table: season window, response, catch NA -> 0

```{r tow-wrangling, message=FALSE}
tow <- read_csv("data/All_Surveys_Combined_v7.3.csv")   # v7.3 = v7.2 + fish-food variables

# Calendar month, day of year, and the water-year clock used by the seasonal spline.
tow$month          <- tow$Month
tow$day            <- yday(as.Date(tow$SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
tow$water_year_day <- get_waterYearDay(as.Date(tow$SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
tow$water_year     <- get_waterYear(as.Date(tow$SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
tow <- tow %>% mutate(CPUE_l_75 = as.numeric(CPUE_l_75))

# December-June = the parr out-migration window analysed throughout; SKT is not modelled.
tow_12_6_not_skt <- tow %>%
  filter(month %in% c(12, 1:6)) %>%
  filter(Survey != "SKT")
tow_12_6_not_skt$survey <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Survey
tow_12_6_not_skt$lat    <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Station_Latitude
tow_12_6_not_skt$lon    <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Station_Longitude

# Response: Chinook < 75 mm fork length (n_l_75). Larger fish are more likely hatchery-origin
# smolts rather than rearing parr. Presence flags kept for the summary tables.
tow_12_6_not_skt$chinook_present_u75     <- ifelse(is.na(tow_12_6_not_skt$CPUE_l_75) |
                                                   tow_12_6_not_skt$CPUE_l_75 <= 0, 0, 1)
tow_12_6_not_skt$chinook_present_allsize <- ifelse(is.na(tow_12_6_not_skt$Chinook_Salmon_CPUE) |
                                                   tow_12_6_not_skt$Chinook_Salmon_CPUE <= 0, 0, 1)

# A missing catch value means no Chinook were caught in that tow.
tow_12_6_not_skt$CPUE_l_75           <- ifelse(is.na(tow_12_6_not_skt$CPUE_l_75), 0, tow_12_6_not_skt$CPUE_l_75)
tow_12_6_not_skt$Chinook_Salmon_CPUE <- ifelse(is.na(tow_12_6_not_skt$Chinook_Salmon_CPUE), 0, tow_12_6_not_skt$Chinook_Salmon_CPUE)
tow_12_6_not_skt$n_l_75              <- ifelse(is.na(tow_12_6_not_skt$n_l_75), 0, tow_12_6_not_skt$n_l_75)

# EDSM reports specific conductivity, not salinity: fill Salinity from it.
# NOTE: the conductivity values are in uS/cm but are passed as mS/cm here, exactly as in the
# original build, so EDSM `Salinity` / `salinity_z` in this file are NOT physically correct.
# No main-text model uses salinity. The appendix rebuilds a corrected EDSM salinity column
# (appendix_salinity_temperature_wateryear/A02_build_edsm_salfix_data.R) and uses only that.
tow_12_6_not_skt <- tow_12_6_not_skt %>%
  mutate(Salinity = ifelse(
    is.na(Salinity) & !is.na(Specific_Conductivity) & !is.na(Temperature),
    swSCTp(c = Specific_Conductivity, t = Temperature, p = rep(0, n()),
           conductivityUnit = "mS/cm", eos = "unesco"),
    Salinity))

# lower-case aliases used by some downstream code
tow_12_6_not_skt$volume        <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Volume
tow_12_6_not_skt$temperature   <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Temperature
tow_12_6_not_skt$habitat2020   <- tow_12_6_not_skt$Habitat2020

tow_12_6_tps_full  <- tow_12_6_not_skt %>% filter(Survey == "TPS")
tow_12_6_edsm_full <- tow_12_6_not_skt %>% filter(Survey == "EDSM")
```

## 2. TPS landscape frame (`tow_12_6_tps_nona`)

Complete cases on the landscape covariates + Secchi + edge/habitat class. Rip Rap edge tows are
dropped (too few to estimate). Every `_z` column is centred and scaled on THIS frame.

```{r tps-landscape}
tow_12_6_tps_nona <- tow_12_6_tps_full %>%
  select(SampleDate, StationCode, Station_Latitude, Station_Longitude, water_year, Volume,
         Chinook_Salmon_Catch, n_l_75, CPUE_l_75, Chinook_Salmon_CPUE,
         chinook_present_u75, chinook_present_allsize, habitat2020, Edge_Type,
         Distance_m, DistanceAlongChannel, OUT_Moving_Mean_30d, Secchi) %>%
  filter(Edge_Type != "Riprap") %>%
  drop_na()
stopifnot(nrow(tow_12_6_tps_nona) == 838)   # the frame the landscape fits were built on

tow_12_6_tps_nona <- tow_12_6_tps_nona %>% mutate(
  distance_m_z             = as.vector(scale(Distance_m)),            # distance off channel
  distance_along_channel_z = as.vector(scale(DistanceAlongChannel)),  # distance along channel
  out30_z                  = as.vector(scale(OUT_Moving_Mean_30d)),   # 30-d mean outflow
  water_year_day           = get_waterYearDay(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  water_year               = get_waterYear(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  secchi_z                 = as.vector(scale(Secchi)))

write.csv(tow_12_6_tps_nona, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tow_12_6_tps_nona.csv"))
```

## 3. TPS water-quality frame (`tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona`)

Adds the water-quality covariates (pH, temperature, DO, Secchi, salinity, chlorophyll), gear and
edge class; complete cases only, Rip Rap dropped.

```{r tps-wq}
tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona <- tow_12_6_tps_full %>%
  select(SampleDate, StationCode, Station_Latitude, Station_Longitude, water_year, Volume,
         Chinook_Salmon_Catch, n_l_75, CPUE_l_75, Chinook_Salmon_CPUE,
         chinook_present_u75, chinook_present_allsize, Distance_m, DistanceAlongChannel,
         OUT_Moving_Mean_30d, pH, Temperature, Dissolved_Oxygen, Secchi, Salinity,
         Chlorophyll, habitat2020, Gear, Edge_Type) %>%
  filter(Edge_Type != "Riprap") %>%
  drop_na()
stopifnot(nrow(tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona) == 818)   # the frame fits_tps_wq_Vfix/ was built on

tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona <- tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona %>% mutate(
  distance_m_z             = as.vector(scale(Distance_m)),
  distance_along_channel_z = as.vector(scale(DistanceAlongChannel)),
  out30_z                  = as.vector(scale(OUT_Moving_Mean_30d)),
  water_year_day           = get_waterYearDay(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  water_year               = get_waterYear(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  ph_z                     = as.vector(scale(pH)),
  temperature_z            = as.vector(scale(Temperature)),
  dox_z                    = as.vector(scale(Dissolved_Oxygen)),
  secchi_z                 = as.vector(scale(Secchi)),
  salinity_z               = as.vector(scale(Salinity)),
  chlorophyll_z            = as.vector(scale(Chlorophyll)))

write.csv(tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona.csv"))
```

## 4. EDSM frame (`tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona`)

EDSM has no edge-type field. Complete cases on the modelled covariates; multiple tows per site
visit are kept (they are handled by the `(1 | StationCode)` random intercept and grouped CV).

```{r edsm}
tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona <- tow_12_6_edsm_full %>%
  select(SampleDate, Month, StationCode, Station_Latitude, Station_Longitude, TowNumber, Volume,
         water_year, Chinook_Salmon_Catch, n_l_75, CPUE_l_75, Chinook_Salmon_CPUE,
         chinook_present_u75, chinook_present_allsize, Distance_m, DistanceAlongChannel,
         OUT_Moving_Mean_30d, Temperature, Dissolved_Oxygen, Secchi, Salinity,
         habitat2020, Gear) %>%
  drop_na()
stopifnot(nrow(tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona) == 4241)  # the frame fits_edsm_Vfix/ was built on

tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona <- tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona %>% mutate(
  distance_m_z             = as.vector(scale(Distance_m)),
  distance_along_channel_z = as.vector(scale(DistanceAlongChannel)),
  out30_z                  = as.vector(scale(OUT_Moving_Mean_30d)),
  water_year_day           = get_waterYearDay(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  water_year               = get_waterYear(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  temperature_z            = as.vector(scale(Temperature)),
  dox_z                    = as.vector(scale(Dissolved_Oxygen)),
  secchi_z                 = as.vector(scale(Secchi)),
  salinity_z               = as.vector(scale(Salinity)))   # see the NOTE in section 1

write.csv(tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona.csv"))
```

## 5. TPS fork-length frame (`tps_forklength_data`)

One row per measured Chinook. Station-level covariates are z-scored on this frame;
`start_depth_z` is the field-recorded start depth (feet) and `water_year_day_z` the scaled
season clock (fork length is modelled with a linear season term, not a spline).

```{r forklength, message=FALSE}
d.tps <- read_csv("data/TPSCatchWithCSLength.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ChinookLength)) %>%
  select(StationCode, TowID, Start_Depth, Gear, Station_Latitude, Station_Longitude,
         Water_Year, SampleDate, Year, Month, Region2020, Habitat2020, Tide, Temperature,
         Dissolved_Oxygen, Specific_Conductivity, Salinity, pH, Turbidity, Chlorophyll,
         Secchi, Volume, Freeport_CFS, Vernalis_CFS, OUT, X2, Edge_Type, TowNumber,
         Target_Caught, fid, DistanceAlongChannel, Distance_m, DistanceToSource,
         Sac_Water_Year_Type, OUT_Moving_Mean_30d, OUT_Moving_Range_7d, shoreline_Class,
         distance_to_shoreline_m, ChinookLength, ChinookClipped) %>%
  # SampleDate is an Excel serial number in this file
  mutate(SampleDate = as_date(SampleDate, origin = "1899-12-30")) %>%
  rename(ForkLength = ChinookLength)
stopifnot(nrow(d.tps) == 134)

d.tps <- d.tps %>% mutate(
  distance_m_z             = as.vector(scale(Distance_m)),
  distance_along_channel_z = as.vector(scale(DistanceAlongChannel)),
  out30_z                  = as.vector(scale(OUT_Moving_Mean_30d)),
  start_depth_z            = as.vector(scale(Start_Depth)),
  water_year_day           = get_waterYearDay(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")),
  water_year_day_z         = as.vector(scale(water_year_day)),
  water_year               = get_waterYear(as.Date(SampleDate, format = "%m/%d/%Y")))

write.csv(d.tps, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tps_forklength_data.csv"))
```

## 6. Check the rebuilt frames against the files the fits were built from

Compares every modelling column (response, offset, covariates, z-scores) of each rebuilt frame
with the copy in `data/`. Columns that no reported model uses are not compared.

```{r verify, message=FALSE}
compare_frame <- function(file, cols) {
  a <- read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, file), show_col_types = FALSE)
  b <- read_csv(file.path("data", file),  show_col_types = FALSE)
  cols <- intersect(cols, intersect(names(a), names(b)))
  tibble(file = file, rows_rebuilt = nrow(a), rows_data = nrow(b),
         columns_compared = length(cols),
         identical = nrow(a) == nrow(b) &&
           all(vapply(cols, function(cc) isTRUE(all.equal(a[[cc]], b[[cc]], tolerance = 1e-10)),
                      logical(1))))
}
model_cols <- c("StationCode", "n_l_75", "Volume", "water_year", "water_year_day", "Edge_Type",
                "habitat2020", "out30_z", "distance_m_z", "distance_along_channel_z",
                "secchi_z", "dox_z", "ph_z", "chlorophyll_z", "ForkLength", "start_depth_z",
                "water_year_day_z")
if (normalizePath(OUT_DIR) != normalizePath("data")) {
  bind_rows(
    compare_frame("tow_12_6_tps_nona.csv",     model_cols),
    compare_frame("tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona.csv",  model_cols),
    compare_frame("tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona.csv", model_cols),
    compare_frame("tps_forklength_data.csv",   model_cols))
}
```
